structured.answer: I'd open the Harel "מניות" track (8522). Harel is a name I know and the biggest one up top, it showed the highest number in its section (24.04% over 3 years), and the fee is about the same as everyone's (0.55%). Harel's S&P 500 track (0.56%, 13.7%) is my fallback.

stuck.where: Harel section, מניות vs עוקב מדד S&P 500
stuck.why: I came for the S&P but the stocks track showed almost double the return for the same fee, so I wasn't sure which to take
Not sure if it's per year or the total over 3 years
The company name appears only once at the top of each section, so after scrolling I lost track of which company a row belonged to
Same track names repeating for company after company; bored, would have closed it on the phone

findings.what: About 140 nearly identical rows with no recommendation or shortlist; overwhelming on a phone
Company name only shown once at the top of its section, so after scrolling you can't tell whose row you're looking at
Fees only shown as small percents, never in shekels, so they all look like nothing and identical
Unclear whether the 3/5-year return is per year or total
Orange '!' and 'עוד לא דווח' looks like a warning and scares me off those rows
No next step or how-to-open button anywhere
Jargon like מט"ח and מההפקדה/מההיסכון without explanation next to it
